SELECT ka.id AS assignmentId, ka.user_id AS userId, u.full_name AS userFullName, COALESCE(( SELECT r.code FROM user_roles ur JOIN roles r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE ur.user_id = u.id ORDER BY CASE upper(trim(both FROM r.code)) WHEN 'GM' THEN 1 WHEN 'PM' THEN 2 WHEN 'LEADER' THEN 3 WHEN 'MEMBER' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END, r.code LIMIT 1 ), '') AS userRoleCode, d.id AS sectionId, d.name AS sectionName, kc.id AS categoryId, kc.name AS categoryName, cy.year AS year, ka.status_code AS statusCode, CASE WHEN ka.evidences IS NULL OR ka.evidences::text = 'null' OR ka.evidences::text = '{}' THEN NULL ELSE 1 END AS evidenceFlag, ka.mid_self_score AS midSelfScore, ka.end_self_score AS endSelfScore, ka.end_pm_score AS endPmScore, ka.end_gm_score AS endGmScore FROM kpi_assignments ka JOIN users u ON u.id = ka.user_id AND u.deleted_at IS NULL JOIN kpi_cycles cy ON cy.id = ka.cycle_id AND cy.deleted_at IS NULL JOIN kpis_information ki ON ki.id = ka.kpi_info_id AND ki.deleted_at IS NULL JOIN kpi_master km ON km.id = ki.master_kpi_id AND km.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN kpi_categories kc ON kc.id = km.category_id AND kc.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN user_departments ud ON ud.user_id = u.id AND ud.is_primary = TRUE LEFT JOIN departments d ON d.id = ud.department_id AND d.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE ka.deleted_at IS NULL AND cy.year = #{year} AND ka.status_code IN (501, 502, 601, 602, 404, 405) ORDER BY ka.status_code DESC, ka.updated_at ASC
